product.title: The Curve Room 2.0 — Salary Cap Simulation
product.summary: Shape a five-year payroll curve instead of spending evenly.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students pick a team with its own competitive situation, then allocate payroll across five years against the cap and the tax line, aiming for a build-peak-reset shape rather than a flat line — which the scoring explicitly penalises — with a live curve chart and league health meter.
product.technology: multi-file static site with Chart.js from a CDN

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: The best-documented lesson repo in the account — five planning and verification documents covering a genuine v1 to v2 rebuild. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: GitHub Pages returned 200 on 2026-08-14. Reachability only.

governance.notes: Depends on a CDN for Chart.js, so it will not run on a fully offline classroom network.

provenance.evidence: 301-M1-L2/VERIFICATION_REPORT.md: 'Educational Design (9th/10th Grade Audience)'; CURVE_ROOM_2.0_PLAN.md names the same audience; DEPLOYMENT.md states 'Time: 10-15 minutes'. Grade band and duration come from planning docs rather than in-app copy.
